About Us

Global Standards of Excellence

AutomateXion is a digital transformation consultancy headquartered in Oman, with operations in Sri Lanka and reach across the Middle East and Asia. Founded by Rizwan Rauf — a 20-year veteran of enterprise technology — we specialise in turning complex digital challenges into measurable, real-world outcomes.

From automating banking remittance workflows to transforming customer operations for oil & gas giants, our track record spans banking, telecoms, manufacturing, capital markets, and conglomerates. We don't just produce roadmaps — we stay until results are realized.

Taxi Driver Behaviour Monitoring & Tracking System

Misbehaviour 38% → 9% 24/7 taxi availability Zero-interaction booking

Issues Rising customer complaints, driver unavailability during peak hours, imbalanced revenue distribution among drivers, and unauthorised/private taxi services operating within the airport.

Outcome Misbehaving driver incidents dropped from 38% to 9%. Taxis available round-the-clock. Customers can book digitally via app or kiosk with zero negotiation.

AI Camera Monitoring Airport Kiosk Mobile App Behaviour Analytics
09
Oil & Gas Company

Digital Delivery Note & IoT Fuel Stock Monitoring

100% error-free process Real-time stock visibility Full DN digitalization

Issues Physical stock tracking caused reorder failures and stock-outs. Fuel stations across the country operated decentralised and manually. Payment disputes arose from missing physically-signed Delivery Notes.

Outcome Complete digitalization of the Delivery Note process via SAP S/4HANA mobile app with digital signatures. IoT sensors across all storage tanks and trucks provide real-time stock data, enabling accurate reordering and delivery scheduling — fully error-free.

SAP S/4HANA Mobile App IoT Sensors Digital Signature Real-time Tracking

How We Work

A Scientific Approach to Transformation

We apply a rigorous, hypothesis-driven methodology that turns ambiguity into a repeatable, measurable programme.

01

Observation & Problem Definition

Current state analysis, stakeholder interviews, process mapping.

02

Hypothesis Formulation

Digital initiatives, KPI design, ROI modelling and feasibility.

03

Experiment Design & Data Collection

Pilot plans, PoC / PoV frameworks, A/B testing, logging.

04

Data Analysis

Performance reports, BI dashboards, cost-benefit analysis.

05

Conclusion & Iteration

Refined strategy, prioritised roadmap, continuous feedback loops.

06

Strategic Roadmap Development & Implementation

Governance framework, change management, phased rollout.

Observation & Problem Definition

We begin with deep stakeholder interviews, detailed process mapping and benchmarking against market leaders. The output is a current state analysis report that pinpoints every friction point, quantifies the opportunity, and frames clear problem statements ready for hypothesis design.

Tools & Methods
Workshop facilitation Process mapping software Survey tools Data visualisation ERP / SAP data extraction CRM feedback analysis
Digital Leadership

Who Leads the Transformation?

Understanding the distinct roles of CIO, CTO, and CDO is the foundation of a well-governed digital programme.

CIO

Chief Information Officer

FocusInternal efficiency & operations
ResponsibilityIT infrastructure, ERP/CRM, cybersecurity, IT governance
Key MetricSystem uptime, IT cost efficiency, security compliance
"The Electrician" — keeps all systems on, secure, and efficient.
CTO

Chief Technology Officer

FocusExternal products & innovation
ResponsibilityTechnology roadmap, R&D, product decisions
Key MetricTime-to-market, product scalability, technical risk
"The Product Architect" — designs and builds the engines of what the company sells.
★ KEY ROLE
CDO

Chief Digital Officer

FocusCustomer experience & digital strategy
ResponsibilityTransformation agenda, data monetisation, new digital models
Key MetricDigital revenue growth, CX scores, adoption rate
"The Growth Strategist" — reimagines how the company interacts with the world.
